message.content:
Based on the screenshot, here is the exact transcription of the visible text and a description of the panel shown:

**Panel/Surface Shown:**
This is the **"Provider accounts"** configuration panel within the **"Context"** tab of an **Untitled task** in the **Flauz** desktop application (an AI coding assistant).

**1. Main Heading**
*   **Untitled task**
*   /tmp/d10-seed-ws

**2. Empty-State Title and Body**
*   **Title:** No provider accounts connected yet
*   **Body:** Connect an account you already have — for example an OpenAI account — and Flauz can run tasks with your quota instead of a shared one. Flauz shows what is left before each run, and never spends a paid account without saying so.

**3. Form Fields and Labels**
*   **Section Label:** Connect a provider account
*   **Sub-label:** OpenAI
*   **Label:** Account name
    *   *Placeholder:* For example: Personal account
*   **Label:** API key
    *   *Placeholder:* Paste the key from your provider
*   **Button:** + Connect account

**4. Section Headings (Account Usage & Limits)**
*   **Heading:** Which account Flauz uses
    *   **Text:** Order today: free accounts first → Change the order
*   **Heading:** Spending and task limits

**5. Footer Hints & Status Messages**
*   **Hint:** The key is stored securely: Flauz never shows it again.
*   **Status Banner:** Codex hit an error and is retrying. [Dismiss]

---
*Other visible text for context:*
*   **Top Bar:** File, Edit, View, Help | Commit or push, Fork, Refresh Git, Changes, Outputs, Browser, Terminal, Computer
*   **Tab Bar:** Context, Agents, Environments, Evidence, More
*   **Status Line:** Model: not chosen yet
*   **Info Lines:** Capabilities (What a task can do...), Save as a reusable workflow, Provider accounts (None connected yet)
*   **Intro Text:** Your provider accounts / Accounts you connect let Flauz run tasks with your provider quota...
